_note: Mirefen side quests (and the Drowned Vault's, given in the fen).

quests.name: Teeth in the Nets
quests.summary: Bo Puddlefoot's nets keep coming back in ribbons. The Gnashing Shallows are thick with crocolisks, and the biggest of them is wearing his nets as a scarf.

stages.description: Thin out the crocolisks of the Gnashing Shallows, south of the Fen Road. Two packs bask in the shallows.

objectives.text: Crocolisks of the Shallows driven off
Crocolisks of the east shallows driven off

stages.description: Old Gnasher lies on the mud bank at the west end of the Gnashing Shallows. Deal with him.
Tell Bo the shallows are safe for nets again. He is by his pond, east of Lowlantern.

quests.name: Fen-Glass and Wisp-Light
quests.summary: Obi Wick, Lowlantern's lanternwright, can make new lanterns for the fen — if somebody brings him fen-glass from the mirelings, who hoard it, and wisp-glow from the wisps, who are it.

stages.description: Collect fen-glass from the mirelings of the Croaking Stones and wisp-glow from the fen wisps of the Mere and Willow Hollow.
Bring the glass and the glow to Obi in Lowlantern.

quests.name: Light the Way
quests.summary: Obi has made four post-lamps for the dark stretches of the Fen Road. Hang them, and the fen folk can walk to the Mere at night again.

stages.description: Hang Obi's lamps on the four dark lamp-posts along the Fen Road, from the Shallows' turning to the Croaking Stones.
Tell Obi the road is lit.

quests.name: The Duke of Puddles
quests.summary: Lily's frog, His Grace the Duke of Puddles, has gone missing. He likes mushroom rings, willows, and anywhere with flies. He answers to 'Your Grace'.

stages.description: Search the fairy ring of toadstools in Willow Hollow, north-east of Lowlantern.
Follow the trail of tiny wet footprints to the willow on the west shore of the Sinking Mere.
The footprints lead south-west, to the mireling camp below the Croaking Stones. There is a stewpot there. Hurry.
Tell Lily what became of His Grace.

quests.name: Rest for the Drowned
quests.summary: The Drowned Barrows are giving back their dead. Old Osric, once of the Heronguard, wants them laid to rest — and the Low Bell rung for them, the way it used to be.

stages.description: Put the bog ghouls of the Drowned Barrows and the Mere back to rest.

objectives.text: Bog ghouls of the Mere laid to rest
Bog ghouls of the Barrows laid to rest
Bog ghouls of the north mounds laid to rest

stages.description: Ring the Low Bell in the ruined arch at the heart of the Barrows, and face whatever answers.
Tell Osric the barrows are quiet.

quests.name: Unbinding the Totems
quests.summary: Old Bloop, an exiled mireling oracle, says the coven's totems whisper to his tribe: bring us the lights. Four of them stand in the western fen. Bloop would like them to stop.

stages.description: Break the four coven totems: on the road into the Croaking Stones, by the Croaker Pool, at the edge of the reeds north of the scouts' camp, and on the old road to the moon-gate.
Tell Bloop the totems are silent.

quests.name: The Croaking Stones
quests.summary: Mireling raiders have been cutting Lowlantern's lines and stealing its lanterns' glass. Their chief, Gubbagulp, holds court in the Croaking Stones. Reeve Tamsin wants it stopped — one way or the other.

stages.description: Go to the Croaking Stones in the south-west and settle things with Chief Gubbagulp. Talking is allowed. So is the other thing.
Tell Reeve Tamsin how it went.

quests.name: Soup of the Mire
quests.summary: Hettie Brine is making her famous Mire Chowder for the first lantern-night in a year. She needs crocolisk tail and fen truffles, and she is not taking no for an answer.

stages.description: Bring Hettie crocolisk tails, and dig fen truffles from under the giant toadstools of Willow Hollow.
Bring the makings to Hettie in Lowlantern.

quests.name: Bounty: Mother Mire's Daughters
quests.summary: Lowlantern is paying, in coin and in gratitude, for every coven hag who stops tying cords to its lanterns.

stages.description: Defeat the coven hags who prowl the western fen and the road to the moon-gate.

objectives.text: The hags at the Sunken Statue
The hag on the gate road

stages.description: Claim the bounty from Reeve Tamsin.

quests.name: The Undertow
quests.summary: Beneath the sunken statue a stair goes down into the old fen temple, where the water drains away toward something that beats. Bloop says a witch lives there who drinks the drowned lights. Go and stop her.

stages.description: Descend into the Drowned Vault beneath the sunken statue, find the Tidewitch at the Heart-Well, and put an end to the undertow.
Bring the news, and the Tidewitch's pearl, to Bloop.
